Bill.BriefDescription: Providing salary bonuses for nationally certified educational staff associates.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing salary bonuses for nationallycertified educational staff associates; and amending RCW 28A.405.415.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.405.415 and 2008 c 175 s 2 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) Certificated instructional staff who have attainedcertification from the national board for professional teachingstandards shall receive a bonus each year in which they maintain thecertification. The bonus shall be calculated as follows: The annualbonus shall be five thousand dollars in the 200708 school year.Thereafter, the annual bonus shall increase by inflation. (b) Beginning in the 201112 school year, educational staffassociates certified as a school speechlanguage pathologist,audiologist, psychologist, occupational therapist, physical therapist,social worker, or school nurse who have attained a national certificatewithin their respective profession shall receive a bonus each year inwhich they maintain the certification. The bonus shall be calculatedas follows: The annual bonus is five thousand dollars, increased byinflation beginning with the 200708 school year. p. 1 HB 2384 (2) Certificated instructional staff who have attainedcertification from the national board for professional teachingstandards shall be eligible for bonuses in addition to that provided bysubsection (1) of this section if the individual is in an instructionalassignment in a school in which at least seventy percent of thestudents qualify for the free and reducedprice lunch program.Beginning in the 201112 school year, educational staff associatescertified as a school speechlanguage pathologist, audiologist,psychologist, occupational therapist, physical therapist, socialworker, or school nurse who have attained a national certificate withintheir respective profession and are in an assignment in a school inwhich at least seventy percent of the students qualify for the free andreducedprice lunch program are eligible for bonuses in addition tothat provided by subsection (1) of this section. (3) The amount of the additional bonus under subsection (2) of thissection for those meeting the qualifications of subsection (2) of thissection is five thousand dollars. (4) The bonuses provided under this section are in addition tocompensation received under a district's salary schedule adopted inaccordance with RCW 28A.405.200 and shall not be included incalculations of a district's average salary and associated salarylimitations under RCW 28A.400.200. (5) The bonuses provided under this section shall be paid in a lumpsum amount.
